Copy exercise sheets into your project

Source: R/tutorials.R
get_tutorial.Rd

Copies the exercise sheet of a tutorial into a folder, where you can open it and write your answers in the empty chunks. If the sheet has a weekly assignment, it comes at the end, and you hand in the sheet itself.

Usage

get_tutorial(
  number,
  dir,
  course = "statistics",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

number

Number of the tutorial, the same as its lecture, such as 4. Several numbers, such as 2:4, or "all" copy several sheets at once. See tutorials() for the sheets available.

dir

Folder to copy the sheets into, such as "." for the current folder of your R project.

course

Which course: "statistics" or "advanced".

overwrite

If TRUE, replace sheets of the same name that are already in dir, answers and all. By default a sheet that is already there is kept: with one number the copy stops with an error, with several numbers or "all" that sheet is skipped and the others are copied.

open

If TRUE, the default in an interactive session, open the sheet after copying it. Only used when you copy one sheet.

Value

The paths of the sheets in dir, invisibly.

Examples

dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(dir)
get_tutorial(4, dir, open = FALSE)
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 4 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/04_linear_models.Rmd.
get_tutorial("all", dir)
#> ℹ Kept /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/04_linear_models.Rmd, which is already there.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 1 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/01_getting_started.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 2 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/02_data_wrangling.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 3 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/03_descriptive_statistics.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 5 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/05_transformations.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 6 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/06_multiple_regression.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 7 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/07_categorical_predictors.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 8 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/08_interactions.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 9 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/09_significance_testing.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 10 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/10_mixed_models_1.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 11 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/11_mixed_models_2.Rmd.
#> ✔ Copied tutorial 12 to /tmp/RtmpHE7Umg/file19d854798503/12_logistic_regression.Rmd.
list.files(dir)
#>  [1] "01_getting_started.Rmd"        "02_data_wrangling.Rmd"        
#>  [3] "03_descriptive_statistics.Rmd" "04_linear_models.Rmd"         
#>  [5] "05_transformations.Rmd"        "06_multiple_regression.Rmd"   
#>  [7] "07_categorical_predictors.Rmd" "08_interactions.Rmd"          
#>  [9] "09_significance_testing.Rmd"   "10_mixed_models_1.Rmd"        
#> [11] "11_mixed_models_2.Rmd"         "12_logistic_regression.Rmd"   
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
